Finite pin disintegration includes the all-hit factor in the exposure marginal. Admissible permutation exterior moments give the unnormalized next-pin determinant identity even at zero all-hit probability, and conditional next-pin mean when that probability is positive. source_observations_pending_curation.source_claim: Soft field q=1-exp(-b) is represented by stationary pinned ghosts and independent Bernoulli switches under the base law. Missing real cycles never switch; at fixed exposure the real-hole kernel killed at ghosts is U=(1-q)K with K doubly stochastic, yielding energy at least q times squared l2 norm. Sparse tests count slot multiplicities, alpha=1/100. For each fixed sufficiently large beta, even L>=Lstar(beta) and q>=L^-5/2, every allowed extra-pin set has sparse avoidance at most beta^(-9|T|/10).
source_observations_pending_curation.limit: The normalized joint pin/picture law is weighted, not an independent posterior product. Bounds are uniform in extra pins, not uniform over all temperatures or finite practical thresholds. No pinned spatial boundary exists on this torus.

source_observations_pending_curation.source_claim: Lift holes locally and make all exterior slots available. Local Nash and infinite unit flows transfer at A=ceil(C beta)<<L. Cutoff flow divergence has l2 error O(L^(1/2-k)), k=199/100; sparse-source pairing retains this term. Ghost killing absorbs it via energy>=q||g||2^2. Return bound includes |T| L^(1-2k)/q <= C L^-47/100. First choose beta large, then L at fixed beta. Integrating finite-volume pressure derivatives before volume and field limits gives m>=S(1-beta^-9/10).
source_observations_pending_curation.limit: Do not place a source without a sink on a finite graph or discard cutoff divergence error. Induction uses strict supersets only. Localization counts distinct actual/fresh marks within at most one period unconditionally; weighted-picture time slices are not independent. No explicit beta0, Lstar or numerical finite-size certificate.

The skeleton communication graph includes all allowed seam endpoints and positive-duration contacts, with endpoint cost Cbeta e_i and contact cost Cbeta(e_i+e_j)/tau. Closed components are allowed and their expected number <=q ell V follows from the resolvent trace. Coarse bad boxes encode six blocked sites, long chronological paths and short-time flags. Separated witness factorial integrals replace unjustified weighted-picture independence. Finite padded periodic lifts and once-applied filled-hull routing construct comparison values.
